question: Which of the following singer is the recipient of the Dadasaheb Phalke Award?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Asha Bhosle**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Dadasaheb Phalke Award** is the highest award in Indian cinema given annually by the Government of India for lifetime contribution to Indian cinema.
 
• **Asha Bhosle** is a legendary playback singer who has sung over 12,000 songs in her career.
 
• She received the Dadasaheb Phalke Award in 2000 for her contribution to Indian cinema.
 
• She is a legendary singer who has been active in the industry for over six decades and has sung in multiple languages.
 
• Sonu Nigam is a popular playback singer who has won several awards for his singing.
 
• Neha Kakkar is a young and popular singer known for her peppy and upbeat tracks.
 
• Arijit Singh is a versatile singer who has won several awards and is known for his soulful voice.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The highest honor in the Indian film industry is the **Dadasaheb Phalke Award**.
 
• The Ministry of Information and Broadcasting established the Directorate of Film Festivals, which presents it yearly at the National Film Awards ceremony.
 
• A committee made up of notable figures from the Indian film industry chooses the recipient, who is recognized for their "outstanding contribution to the growth and development of Indian cinema".
 
• The Government of India instituted the prize in 1969 as a way to honour Dadasaheb Phalke's contribution to Indian cinema.
